text: This report recommends approval of travel expenses for Michelle Lovrics, Event and Meeting Coordinator to attend the first year and the second year respectively of the International Association of Venue Managers (IAVM), Venue Management School (VMS).

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Authorized travel expenses for Michelle Lovrics, Event and Meeting Coordinator to attend the International Association of Venue Managers School in Tampa, Florida from June 4 to June 10, 2023, at a cost not expected to exceed $6,500 plus HST for flights, accommodation, and incidental expenses.
